name: Tabbed Notepad

props.text: Use New tab to add notes. A star marks unsaved changes.

startup:
# Register the designer-created first page; later pages use tabs_add.
self.note_counter = 1
first_tab = str(self.NotesTabs.pages["Note 1"])
self.notes = {first_tab: {"text": self.NoteText1, "path": None, "title": "Note 1", "saved": ""}}
self.NoteText1.edit_modified(False)
self.NoteText1.bind("<<Modified>>", lambda event: tabs_modified(self, first_tab))
self.Form1.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", lambda: tabs_close_app(self))
self.Form1.deiconify()
